articles.title: Flyers Unveil Independence Edition Campaign Including Exclusive Retail Capsule

out.detail: injured (upper body), will miss fifth straight game

away.summary: The Flyers (4-9-4) are in Manhattan for the first of four Metropolitan Division meetings with the Rangers. They come off a 4-2 home loss to Minnesota on Tuesday despite creating quality chances, with Tyson Foerster and Denver Barkey providing the offense. The projected lineup features rookie Porter Martone and a defensive pairing of Travis Sanheim with Jamie Drysdale, while Dan Vladar is listed as the second goalie option.

out.detail: injured (lower body), on conditioning stint with Hartford
injured (undisclosed), placed on injured reserve retroactive to Oct. 26

home.summary: The Rangers (8-7-1) bounced back Tuesday with a 3-1 win over St. Louis, as Dylan Garand stopped 32 of 33 shots. With Igor Shesterkin and Joonas Korpisalo both injured, Garand is projected to start again with James Reimer as backup after Reimer cleared waivers. The lineup includes recent recall Jaroslav Chmelar, while Sean Durzi will miss a third straight game.
